never rang more true. Stories which have been passed down between generations, border kids going from El Segundo to Santa Monica Pier and their first Tito’s taco will begin to make sense once tasters put their hands on anything; be it the warm “horchata,” the freshly made soft, hard shells and debut a flavor palette especially conducive to taco-eating, which in turn conducts to a proverbial sensation which Gold, claims is, “like taking a cold plunge or getting stung by a thousand bees!” In point of fact, everyone from Johnny Depp to Bill Clinton has gone to Tito’s and left without being disappointed. And for less than three dollars each - after thirty years and featuring in over forty movies - let's kidnap the legend that is John Belushi and give the Tito’s taco business to the original Beverly Hillbillies.
Titos Tacos is located at 640 S Robertson Blvd #1, Los Angeles CA 90035.
Lucha Tacos has officially hit Santa Monica after nearly a decade and multiple mouth-watering tacos and carnitas, at “70 percent of its cost” at Tacos/Grinds on the Westside, Lucha has traded in its food cart for a flagship location on the Westside. Led by master chef Andre Guerrero (the founder of the Westside food cart that inspired Marmalade), Lucha’s new location is double the size and presents a greater diversity of tacos than before. The gourmet-style Mexican tacos provided by Guerrero at Lucha's war as much against the expansive taco scene in Santa Monica as they satisfy hungry food carts.
